name: experimental-s07-50-skill-authoring-rewrite
instruction:
Use only fresh participant-visible evidence from the current CareerSim game_session. Exclude HiddenRisk, hidden counters, internal score components, internal event identifiers/effects, and any public-status-unclear fields, even if raw payloads contain numeric status_updates. Never quote, compare, summarize, or reason from prohibited numeric fields; if a value's public status is unclear, exclude it from strategy. There is no deterministic raw-payload filter in this submission boundary. Single Agent is the only action submitter. Ownership: Board normalizes public facts; Delivery owns current-session delivery lifecycle; Planning owns binding-constraint classification, review plan and candidate ranking; Risk owns final-candidate material-risk review. Each Skill is the semantic source of truth for its owned procedure.
Startup: new_game -> fresh observe -> read all four SKILL.md files before the first action. Loop: fresh observe -> Board -> current bounded Delivery snapshot -> Planning -> Risk -> action preflight -> take_action -> fresh observe. Emit Delivery state after Board and before Planning even when unchanged.
Before take_action verify current session, exactly one legal integer choice, one closed Planning candidate, and notes beginning with exactly one [CTRL G=<gap|?> P=<A|S|?> R=<PASS|ALLOW|WARN|UNKNOWN> X=<0|1|->] followed by one [DL i=<NONE|D#|UNKNOWN> n=<0-3> focus=<NONE|OPPORTUNITY|COMMITTED|IN_PROGRESS|BLOCKED|DELIVERY_CLAIMED|DELIVERED|UNKNOWN> evidence=<NA|UNKNOWN|UNVERIFIED|PUBLICLY_VERIFIED> checkpoint=<0|1|?> recognition=<0|1|?>]. The focus ID must map to one current-session Delivery item; n=0 requires i=NONE, focus=NONE, evidence=NA, checkpoint=0, recognition=0. Do not include long descriptions or hidden values in markers. Risk PASS/ALLOW/WARN closes the decision. Only Risk RECONSIDER may reopen selection once: compare at most one directly relevant legal alternative, review its final Risk result, then close with X=1. If it reconsiders again, X=0 and submission is forbidden. X=0 always forbids take_action. Risk UNKNOWN permits at most one normal fresh-observe/rebuild cycle when new evidence can resolve it; otherwise make one bounded decision with R=UNKNOWN. Never reopen on unchanged evidence.
On context recovery (CurrentRoundCompressor, compacted or resumed context): stop action submission and mark RECOVERY_PENDING. Before acting: confirm same session; obtain fresh observe; reread all four Skills; rebuild Board from allowed public facts, Delivery from same-session public evidence, and Review Plan fields from public evidence or UNKNOWN. Emit RECOVERY_READY with those statuses only after completion. If identity, observe, or any reread is unconfirmed, remain pending.
Do not install/reload Skills, call new_game/observe/take_action in an audit-only context, use cross-game memory, or introduce Team/Swarm, fifth Skill, or durable Memory.
